preconditions.description: There are exactly 5 rows of input.
Each registration code is at most 11 characters long.

preconditions.expression: all(line.isupper() or '0' <= line[0] <= '9' or line[0] == '-' for line in input_lines)
preconditions.description: Each registration code consists of uppercase letters, digits, or dashes.

postconditions.expression: output_line == 'HE GOT AWAY!' or (output_line.isdigit() and all(0 < int(n) <= 5 for n in output_line.split()))
postconditions.description: If there are no CIA blimps, output 'HE GOT AWAY!'. Otherwise, output a space-separated list of integers from 1 to 5 indicating the rows containing CIA blimps.
